recalls.summary: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2019-2020 Ascent, 2018 Forester, 2018-2020 Impreza, Legacy, Outback, 2018-2019 BRZ, WRX, and Toyota 86 vehicles.  The low-pressure fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.

Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2015-2018 Forester vehicles equipped with heated seats.  An electrical connection in the front passenger seat for the Occupant Detection System (ODS) may loosen.

Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2018 Subaru Forester vehicles.  The Certification Label may indicate the incorrect wheel size, tire size, and air pressure.
